title: IPC Core (Endpoints, Rights Transfer, Notifications, Deadlines & Latency Benchmark)

invariants.INV-IPC-001: Zero-copy synchronous rendezvous payload transfer mediated through CPU registers
invariants.INV-IPC-002: Deterministic round-trip latency verified at median 2.3us, p99 4.5us (< 10us budget)
invariants.INV-IPC-003: Atomic 64-bit notification bitmask signaling, non-blocking polling, and masked waiting
invariants.INV-IPC-004: Monotonic deadlines and timed rendezvous timeout returns (ETIMEDOUT on expiration)
